meta.project: E-Commerce Demo (React Frontend with Mock Data)

product_overview: A small React-based e-commerce demo that lets visitors browse products, authenticated users simulate purchases and view order history, and authenticated admins manage product data in the UI. All data is mock/hardcoded in the frontend; there is no backend or persistent storage.
core_goals: Browse a catalog of mock products and inspect product details.
Authenticate with the provided test account to purchase products.
Simulate purchases and view those orders in an order history page.
Allow an authenticated admin to add, edit, and remove products in the app UI (changes do not persist).

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users sign in with a single hardcoded test account to access purchase and protected pages; authentication state is held in React context for the session.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email with example@gmail.com -> Fill in password with 123456789 -> Submit login form -> See product catalog
Navigate to /login -> Fill in email with invalid@example.com -> Fill in password with wrongpass -> Submit login form -> See "Invalid credentials." error message
Be authenticated -> Log out -> Get redirected to /login

features.name: Route Protection
features.description: Protected routes redirect unauthenticated visitors to the login page so only signed-in users can access orders and admin pages.
user_flows: Navigate to /orders while unauthenticated -> Get redirected to /login
Navigate to /admin while unauthenticated -> Get redirected to /login

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: Visitors can browse a list of mock products; authenticated users can initiate purchases from the catalog.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse product cards and overview information
Authenticate -> Navigate to / -> Browse product cards -> Initiate purchase for a product from the catalog -> See "Purchase successful!" snackbar
Navigate to / while unauthenticated -> Browse product cards -> Attempt to initiate a purchase -> Observe purchase action is disabled

features.name: Product Details
features.description: Show a detailed view of a single product including image, name, category, price, and description; purchases can be initiated from this page when authenticated.
user_flows: Open product details from the catalog -> See product image, name, category, price, and description
Authenticate -> Open product details from the catalog -> Initiate purchase for this product -> See "Purchase successful!" snackbar
On product details page -> Return to the product catalog

features.name: Order History
features.description: Authenticated users can view a list of their mock orders, each showing product image, name, price, and the order Date field.
user_flows: Authenticate -> Navigate to /orders -> View list of order cards showing product image, name, price, and Date field

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Authenticated admin users can add, edit, and delete products in the app UI; all changes are local to the session and not persisted to any backend.
user_flows: Authenticate -> Navigate to /admin -> Fill in product name -> Fill in product category -> Fill in product price -> Fill in product description -> Fill in product image URL -> Submit add product form -> See snackbar "Product added (UI only, not persisted)."

Authenticate -> Navigate to /admin -> Select an existing product to edit -> Update product fields (name, category, price, description, or image URL) -> Save changes -> See updated product in the admin list
Authenticate -> Navigate to /admin -> Select an existing product to delete -> Confirm deletion -> See product removed from the admin list

tech_stack.other: No backend — all data is hardcoded mock data

routes.description: Login page with hardcoded credential check
Product catalog listing all mock products
Order history page showing mock orders
Admin panel for managing products (UI only)

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Login with hardcoded credentials example@gmail.com / 123456789. Auth state held in React context only (no persistence).
user_interactions: Navigate to /login
Fill email input with example@gmail.com
Fill password input with 123456789
Click Login button
On success, redirected to product catalog
On failure, see "Invalid credentials." error message
Click Logout button in AppBar to log out

features.name: Route Protection
features.description: /orders and /admin routes redirect unauthenticated users to /login via RequireAuth component.
user_interactions: Navigate to /orders or /admin without being logged in
Gets redirected to /login

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: Displays all mock products as cards. Each card shows product image, name, category, and price. Buy button is disabled when user is not authenticated.
user_interactions: Browse product cards on homepage
Click "View Details" to navigate to product detail page
Click "Buy" button (only enabled when authenticated) to trigger purchase
See "Purchase successful!" snackbar after buying

features.name: Product Details
features.description: Shows detail view for a single product including image, name, category, price, and description. Buy button disabled when unauthenticated.
user_interactions: View product image, name, category, price, description
Click "Buy" button (only enabled when authenticated) to trigger purchase
See "Purchase successful!" snackbar after buying
Click back button or nav to return to catalog

features.name: Order History
features.description: Shows a list of mock orders for the authenticated user. Each order card displays product image, name, price, and date.
user_interactions: Log in first
Navigate to "Orders" link in AppBar
View list of order cards with product image, name, price, and Date field

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Authenticated admin can add, edit, and delete products via a form. All operations are UI-only and not persisted to any backend.
user_interactions: Log in first
Navigate to "Admin" link in AppBar
Fill in product form fields (name, category, price, description, image URL)
Click "Add Product" to add (shows snackbar "Product added (UI only, not persisted).")
Click edit icon on existing product to edit
Click delete icon on existing product to remove from list

known_limitations.issue: Auth state is not persisted — refreshing the page logs the user out
known_limitations.impact: Tests that rely on staying logged in across page refreshes will fail

known_limitations.issue: All product and order data is hardcoded mock data
known_limitations.impact: No real backend; CRUD operations in AdminPage only update local React state

known_limitations.issue: Admin snackbar message is "Product added (UI only, not persisted)." not "Product added successfully"
known_limitations.impact: Test assertions expecting "Product added successfully" will fail

known_limitations.issue: Order History page heading is "Order History" not "Your Orders"
known_limitations.impact: Test assertions expecting "Your Orders" will fail

known_limitations.issue: Order date field label is "Date:" not "Order Date"
known_limitations.impact: Test assertions expecting "Order Date" will fail
